definitions.short: Kenaanah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H3668. Kenaanah כְּנַעֲנָה proper name, masculine 1. father of prophet Zedekiah 1Kin 22:11 , 24 2Chr 18:10 , 23 ( ᵐ5 Ξανααν , Ξαανα , Ξανανα ). 2 a Benjamite 1Chr 7:10 ( ᵐ5 Ξανααν , Ξαναναν ). כנף √ of following (meaning dubious; Arabic fence in, enclose , and Aramaic כְּנַף collect, assemble , are denominative)
